pack.name: Azure Resiliency & Disaster Recovery
pack.description: Multi-region, availability zones, RTO/RPO, and backup themes for Azure workloads.

rules.title: Availability targets documented per workload tier
rules.description: Each service tier must state availability objective (e.g., 99.9%, 99.99%) so reliability design can be assessed against business need.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag tier and SLA target on services[].Tags; document targets in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: RTO and RPO defined for tier-1 systems
rules.description: Business-critical components must document recovery time and recovery point objectives — not undefined best-effort DR.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record RTO/RPO in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription for tier-1 services and datastores.

rules.title: Multi-region deployment for critical workloads
rules.description: Tier-1 services should document active-active or active-passive multi-region strategy with failover triggers.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe region pairs in metadata.ChangeDescription; align region tags on services[].Tags with azureExtractor locations.

rules.title: Availability Zones used for fault isolation
rules.description: Stateful and stateless tiers should document AZ spread within region for zone-level failure tolerance.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag zonal deployment on services[].Tags; verify zone redundancy in azureExtractor compute and data inventory.

rules.title: Regional paired disaster recovery documented
rules.description: DR strategy must reference Azure region pairs or explicit cross-region replication topology.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document DR region mapping in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Backup policy and retention documented
rules.description: All production datastores must document backup frequency, retention, and encryption for backup media.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe backup policy in governance.RequiredControls and datastores[].Tags.

rules.title: Backup restore testing cadence
rules.description: Restore tests must be scheduled and documented — backups without tested restore provide false assurance.
rules.remediationGuidance: Add restore-test cadence to governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Geo-redundant storage for critical data
rules.description: Blob, table, and queue tiers holding tier-1 data should document GRS or GZRS replication.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag replication SKU on datastores[].Tags; cite storage redundancy from azureExtractor.

rules.title: SQL geo-replication or failover groups
rules.description: Azure SQL tier-1 databases must document auto-failover groups or geo-replication with RPO alignment.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document SQL DR topology in governance.RequiredControls and datastores[].Tags.

rules.title: Cosmos DB multi-region write or failover
rules.description: Cosmos accounts must document multi-region consistency level and automatic failover configuration.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture Cosmos DR settings in governance.PolicyConstraints and azureExtractor Cosmos inventory.

rules.title: Traffic Manager or Front Door failover routing
rules.description: Global entry points must document health-probed failover between regional endpoints.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag global load balancer services and routing policy in services[].Tags and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Chaos engineering or fault injection themes
rules.description: Production-critical systems should reference game days, chaos experiments, or AZ failure drills.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note resilience testing in governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Dependency failure modes documented
rules.description: External SaaS, DNS, identity, and payment dependencies must list failure impact and degraded-mode behavior.
rules.remediationGuidance: Enumerate dependencies on relationships[]; document fallback in services[].Purpose and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Circuit breaker and retry policies
rules.description: Inter-service calls must document retry, timeout, and circuit-breaker patterns preventing cascade failures.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe resilience patterns in governance.RequiredControls and services[].Tags for API consumers.

rules.title: Queue-based load leveling for spikes
rules.description: Burst traffic paths should document buffering (Service Bus, Event Hubs) to protect downstream tiers.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag queue-mediated flows on relationships[] and services[].Tags.

rules.title: Autoscaling rules documented
rules.description: Compute tiers must document scale-out/in triggers, limits, and warm-up time for traffic spikes.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture autoscale policy in governance.PolicyConstraints and services[].Tags.

rules.title: Health probes and synthetic monitoring
rules.description: User-facing services must document health endpoints and synthetic transactions validating end-to-end paths.
rules.remediationGuidance: List health check endpoints in governance.RequiredControls and services[].Tags.

rules.title: Deployment slots and blue-green patterns
rules.description: Production releases should document slot swap or blue-green deployment with rollback lever.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe deployment strategy in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Immutable infrastructure for stateless tiers
rules.description: Stateless app tiers should document image-based redeploy rather than in-place patching for consistency.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag immutable deploy pattern on services[].Tags; reference container/VMSS images in metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Data consistency model documented
rules.description: Distributed data paths must document consistency trade-offs (strong vs eventual) and conflict resolution.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture consistency choices in governance.PolicyConstraints and datastores[].Tags.

rules.title: Maintenance window and update orchestration
rules.description: Platform maintenance (AKS upgrades, SQL patching) must document schedule, notification, and blast-radius control.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document maintenance orchestration in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Capacity planning and quota headroom
rules.description: Subscriptions must document quota limits, reserved capacity, and headroom for growth and DR failover.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note quota and capacity plans in governance.PolicyConstraints; align with azureExtractor subscription metadata.

rules.title: DR runbook and communication plan
rules.description: Failover runbooks must identify roles, communication trees, and customer notification for major outages.
rules.remediationGuidance: Reference DR runbook in governance.RequiredControls and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Secrets and config available during DR
rules.description: Failover regions must document Key Vault replication, config sync, and identity availability during regional loss.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe secret DR in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Network DR connectivity documented
rules.description: Cross-region VNet peering, VPN, or ExpressRoute failover must be documented for DR traffic paths.
rules.remediationGuidance: Map DR network paths in metadata.ChangeDescription; align with azureExtractor network inventory.

rules.title: Ransomware-resistant backup (immutable)
rules.description: Critical backups should document immutability, air-gap, or M365/Azure Backup vault soft-delete protections.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag immutable backup on datastores[].Tags and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Observability during incident and DR
rules.description: Monitoring and alerting must remain available during regional degradation — document observability DR.
rules.remediationGuidance: List observability failover in governance.RequiredControls and security/ops services[].Tags.

rules.title: Post-incident review and reliability backlog
rules.description: Architecture should reference blameless postmortems feeding reliability improvements — not static DR docs only.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note PIR process in governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription.
